text:
As Liberty Global Plc (LBTYK) Stock Declined, Salzman & Company Has Boosted Position; Holowesko Partners LTD Upped Its Stake in Jd Com (JD) as Market Value Rose 
March 11, 2018 - By Ellis Scott 
Salzman & Company increased its stake in Liberty Global Plc (LBTYK) by 3.58% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Salzman & Company bought 51,275 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.26% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund held 1.48 million shares of the television services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $48.53 million, up from 1.43M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Salzman & Company who had been investing in Liberty Global Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $26.53B market cap company. The stock increased 2.01% or $0.64   $32.43. About 2.03 million shares traded. Liberty Global plc (NASDAQ:LBTYK) has declined 6.78% since March 11, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.48% the S&P500. 
Holowesko Partners Ltd increased its stake in Jd Com Inc (JD) by 43.96% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Holowesko Partners Ltd bought 511,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 37.55% with the market. The hedge fund held 1.67 million shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $63.93 million, up from 1.16M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Holowesko Partners Ltd who had been investing in Jd Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $65.20B market cap company. The stock increased 0.71% or $0.32   $45.71. About 10.07 million shares traded. JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) has risen 77.67%   60.97% the S&P500. 
Salzman & Company, which manages about $433.67 million and $82.50M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Liberty Media Corp Delaware by 445,103 shares to 395,040 shares, valued at $16.55 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. 
Holowesko Partners Ltd, which manages about $4.09B and $1.26B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in American Express Co (NYSE:AXP) by 529,000 shares to 956,000 shares, valued at $86.48M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 36,800 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 272,000 shares, and cut its stake in General Dynamics Corp (NYSE:GD). 
Among 22 analysts covering JD.com ( NASDAQ:JD ), 17 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 5 Hold. Therefore 77% are positive. JD.com had 48 analyst reports since August 4,   As per Tuesday, October 3, the company rating was maintained by Jefferies. The stock of JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) earned “Market Perform” rating by Bernstein on Tuesday, May 9. The firm has “Neutral” rating given on Thursday, August 11 by Bank of America. The rating was upgraded by UBS on Monday, October 30 to “Buy”. JP Morgan initiated JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) on Wednesday, August 31 with “Neutral” rating. KeyBanc Capital Markets maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Monday, November 13 report. The stock of JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) earned “Buy” rating by Jefferies on Monday, July 17. On Wednesday, December 13 the stock rating was maintained by Stifel Nicolaus with “Buy”. Credit Suisse downgraded it to “Neutral” rating and $21 target in Tuesday, May 10 report. JP Morgan maintained it with “Overweight” rating and $50 target in Wednesday, November 15 report.   Ellis Scott
